title: Scriptorium Session Summary v1
description: A supported agent-host session's normalized writeback (see specs/sync-layer.md §4). Claude Code may enqueue from SessionEnd; Codex currently uses an on-demand local-log scan. The document separates low-risk `timeline` facts from gated high-value claims (`status`/`stage`/`next_actions`/`conclusion`/`blocked_by`). `summary_id` is the idempotency key for the append-only progress-log writer.

summary_id.description: Stable id = the idempotency key; re-applying the same summary_id is a no-op (no double-logging).

project.description: Owning project_id (project/1.0); resolved from the session cwd.

approval_state.description: Lifecycle: draft -> approved (user) -> applied (written to project note + memory).

session_id.description: Source agent-host session id, if available.

timeline.description: Auto, low-risk facts (files touched / commits / session bullets); applied without approval.

status.description: Gated high-value claim: proposed project status (project/1.0 enum).

stage.description: Gated high-value claim: proposed FREE-TEXT project phase (project/1.0 `stage`); no enum, unlike status.

next_actions.description: Gated high-value claim: proposed next steps.

blocked_by.description: Gated high-value claim: what blocks progress, empty if none.
